{{Quote|We recently found a prize vessel&hellip;one whose value could enable us to retire in luxury.|Garik Loran to Kosh Teradoc|<ref name="Mercy Kill">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''''The Palace of Piethet Brighteyes''''' was a legendary [[treasure ship]] that disappeared [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]]. This event occurred during a flashback set in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> during a covert [[Mission to Ryvester|operation]] conducted by [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryvester]], Wraith leader [[Garik Loran]] went undercover as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Hachat. Meeting with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]] at a [[Unidentified club (Ryvester)|club]], he falsely claimed to have discovered the vessel intact and offered to divide its treasure with Teradoc in exchange for the admiral's assistance in disabling the vessel's security defenses.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
